title: Sources
autoRefreshHint: Reloads the channel list on startup when it is more than a day old.
autoRefreshUnavailable: Pasted playlists can't refresh. Add it by URL or file to keep it current.
playlistUrlHint: The link your provider gave you, usually ending in .m3u or .m3u8.
fileHintDesktop: The file is read again on every refresh, so keep it where it is.
fileHintWeb: The file's contents are copied in. Choose it again to pick up changes.
playlistTextHint: Paste the full playlist, starting with #EXTM3U.
xtreamLinkDetected: This looks like an Xtream Codes link. Adding it as an account also brings in movies and series.
requestHeadersHint: Only needed when your provider rejects the default player.
serverUrlHint: Include the port if your provider gave one, for example http://example.com:8080.
passwordSpaceHint: The password starts or ends with a space. Remove it unless it is part of the password.
portalUrlHint: The address you would type into a MAG box, for example http://example.com/c/.
macHint: Twelve hex digits. Separators are added for you.
macOuiHint: Most portals expect a MAC starting with {{oui}}. Check this matches what your provider registered.
fullPortalHint: Turn on for portals served from /stalker_portal. Detected from the URL when possible.
deviceIdentityHint: Leave these empty unless your provider asks for them.
testFailedGeneric: The server didn't accept these details.
addedDescriptionGuide_one: {{count}} item imported. The TV guide is loading in the background.
addedDescriptionGuide_other: {{count}} items imported. The TV guide is loading in the background.
savedNeedsRefresh: Refresh to load channels with the new details.
textOriginNotEditable: This playlist was pasted in, so there is no address to change. Remove it and add it again to replace the channels. The request headers below still apply to every stream.
epgLinksHint: Guide URLs found in the playlist plus any you add. Turn one off to stop fetching it.
epgLinksEmpty: No guide URLs yet. Add one below.
sourceErrorRefused: {{host}} refused the connection. Check the address and port, and that the server is running.
sourceErrorDns: Couldn't find {{host}}. Check the address for typos.
sourceErrorNetwork: Couldn't reach {{host}}. Check the address and that the server is online.
sourceErrorTimeout: {{host}} didn't answer in time. Check that the server is online, then try again.
sourceErrorAuth: The provider turned down the sign-in. Check the username and password, or the MAC address.
sourceErrorNotFound: The address wasn't found on the server. Check the URL; the provider may have changed it.
sourceErrorServer: {{host}} is busy or having trouble. Try again later.
sourceErrorWrongUrl: {{host}} didn't send a channel list. Use the playlist URL from your provider, not a link to a single channel or a web page.
removeBody: Its channels, favorites, watch history and My List titles go with it. You can add the source again later.
reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or focus a card and press Alt with the arrow keys.
reorderInstructions: Press the arrow keys to move this source. Home and End move it to the top or bottom.
onboardLead: Pick the kind of login your provider gave you. You can add more later.
onboardM3uBody: A link or file listing channels, usually ending in .m3u.
onboardM3uNeeds: A URL, a file, or the playlist text
onboardXtreamBody: Live TV, movies and series from an account login.
onboardStalkerBody: The portal and MAC address used by MAG set-top boxes.
errorUrlInvalid: Enter a full address, like http://example.com/list.m3u.
errorUrlScheme: Only http and https addresses work here.
errorNotM3u: This doesn't look like a playlist. It should start with #EXTM3U or contain stream URLs.
errorHeaderValue: Header values must fit on one line.
errorReferrer: Enter a full address for the Referer.
errorOrigin: Origin is a scheme and host only, like https://example.com.
errorEpgDuplicate: That URL is already in the list.
hintNetwork: Check the address and your connection, then try again.
hintTimeout: The server took too long. Try again in a minute.
hintAuth: The server rejected the login. Check the username, password or MAC.
hintInvalid: The server's response wasn't usable. Check the address points at the right service.
hintUnsupported: This server uses a format the app doesn't support yet.
hintConflict: A source with these details already exists.
hintNotFound: Nothing was found at that address. Check the URL.
hintGeneric: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the details with your provider.
hintWrongUrl: Use the playlist URL from your provider, not a link to a single channel, a video, or a web page.
errorSummaryTimeout: The server didn't answer in time.
errorSummaryAuth: The server didn't accept the login.
errorSummaryInvalid: The playlist or the server's answer couldn't be read.
errorSummaryUnsupported: This kind of source isn't supported.
errorSummaryNotFound: The server has no playlist at that address.
errorSummaryWrongUrl: That address doesn't lead to a channel list.
addRetryNote: "{{name}}" was saved with this error. Fix the details and try again here, or close this window and use Try again on its card later.
accountLead: Subscription details reported by the provider.
accountLoadFailed: Could not load the account details
accountEmpty: The portal did not report any account details.
sortedHint: Sorted list. Drag to reorder in your order only.
filteredEmptyBody: Change the type or status filter to see more.
removeAllBody_one: The playlist, its channels, favorites, watch history, My List titles and guide links are deleted. Downloaded files stay on disk.
removeAllBody_other: Every playlist, with its channels, favorites, watch history, My List titles and guide links, is deleted. Downloaded files stay on disk.
removeAllLockedTitle: Enter the PIN to remove the playlists
removeLockedText: Parental locks are removed with the playlist, so the PIN unlocks parental controls first.
cancelledKeptCatalog: The channels from the last import are kept.
cancelledAddNote: Nothing was added. Your details are still here when you want to try again.
cancelledRetryNote: The source was left as it was. Your details are still here when you want to try again.
removedUndoHint: Its channels, favorites, watch history and My List titles go with it.
removeFailedKept: The source is back in your list.
removedAnnouncement: {{name}} removed. Press F8 to reach Undo.
errorFileTooLarge: This file is {{size}}, too large to open here. Put it at a web address and add it as a URL.
sourceErrorAuth_m3u: The server turned down the playlist download. Check the playlist URL, or the login in it.
sourceErrorAuth_xtream: The provider turned down the sign-in. Check the username and password.
sourceErrorAuth_stalker: The portal turned down the sign-in. Check the MAC address registered with your provider.
sourceErrorInvalid: {{host}} sent something the app couldn't read. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the address with your provider.
errorSummaryServer: The server is busy or having trouble.
hintServer: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, ask your provider.
sourceErrorUnreadable: {{host}} sent a reply the app couldn't read. Check the server URL.
accountConnectionsFullHint: Every connection is in use. Another stream from this account will likely be refused.
catchupOverrideHint: Replaces the playlist's catch-up attributes for every live channel in this source.
catchupTemplateHint: Placeholders such as {utc}, {lutc}, {start}, {end}, {duration} and {Y}-{m}-{d}. Leave empty for the type's standard address.
catchupDaysHint: How far back the archive reaches. Leave empty to keep the playlist's value.
errorCatchupTemplate: Use at most {{max}} characters and no control characters.
errorCatchupDays: Enter a whole number of days from one to {{max}}.
